QuestInfo.name: Moren's New Discovery
QuestInfo.0: #b#m261000000##k is the land where Alcadnos and Zenumists form an uneasy truce in... One day, a news exploded in the Maple World where an alchemist from Zenumist, #b#p2110004##k, discovered a new method that will change the way alchemy works. #p2110004# was also looking for a capable apprentice that will spread his work to mainstream, and this caused a huge number of people to head over to #m261000000#...\r\nHe's apparently staying at #m261000002# of #m261000000#, which is a town of alchemists at Nihal Desert.
QuestInfo.1: After spending a number of years conducting experiments, #b#b#p2110004##k, an alchemist under Zenumist Society, finally discovered a #bnew method#k of producing items, where the item can be created solely out of alchemy. To learn his new method, I visited #p2110004#. He said in order to acquire this new method, I'll have to take three classes... #bthe fundamentals of alchemy, the basic theory of science, and the actual application of alchemy#k...Sheesh, when can I attend all those classes?
QuestInfo.2: #b#m261000000##k is the land where Alcadno and Zenumist form an uneasy truce in... One day #p2110004#, the alchemist from Zenumist, #b#p2110004##k, discovered a new method of item creation that relies solely on alchemy. Apparently, #p2110004# has been looking for an apprentice for his new method, so I went ahead to #m261000000# to visit him.

0.0: What is it?!\r\n#b#L0#I have come to see you and your new method.#l
0.1: So what do you want to talk about?! If you have something to say, make it quick!\r\n#b#L0#Oh..okay! I'd like to learn the new method you discovered...(He's intimidating.)#l
0.2: Good! I like your attitude! After working on this for years, I was finally able to discover a new method that will enable me to forego blacksmithing and produce an item purely out of alchemy. Unlike the blacksmithing technique, which requires years of practice, this method can be easily mastered by studying the theory behind it! After discovering this groundbreaking new method, I was looking for an apprentice that is willing to spread the word on this! What do you think? Are you ready to learn this?!\r\n#L0##bYes, I am!#l
0.3: Great! My new method is called #e#b#q1007##k#n! Are you ready to start?

yes.0: Fully mastering #q1007# requires the following: the fundamentals of alchemy, the basic theory of science, and the actual application of alchemy! Are you writing this down? You'll need to take these three classes, and then I will test you on this! You must pass this test in order for me to pass #q1007# down to you! Got it?
